intent_record.intent_summary: Fix CRC8 calculation loop bounds by using the resolved relative index variables instead of the static configuration limits.

intent_record.how: This ensures the CRC8 checksum calculation iterates over the correctly resolved relative index range instead of using the static configuration limits directly.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix the CRC8 destination offset in cgw_csum_crc8_rel by using the calculated relative index variable.
intent_record.what: Replaced the array index 'crc8->result_idx' with the local variable 'res' when writing the calculated CRC8 checksum to 'cf->data'.
intent_record.how: Ensures the checksum is stored at the correctly calculated relative index 'res' rather than the static 'crc8->result_idx'.
